data.title: 波岛出海 · 樱花坂道黄昏的单车推行与心意 (POV)
data.description: 东京都郊外坡道两侧盛开着淡粉樱花，黄昏夕阳把整个坡道染成赤金。第一人称POV视角下，出海推着带车筐的淑女单车漫步，停步抬头看向镜头前的你，双颊绯红、眼眸闪动地倾诉着对同人创作的心意，纯情又羞涩。
data.location: sloping suburban residential avenue flanked by blooming cherry blossoms and glowing sunset
data.action: pushing her bicycle along the cherry blossom slope, pausing to look directly at the viewer with blushing cheeks and an earnest, shy smile, golden sunset wind fluttering around her
data.lighting: 斜照坡道的浓郁赤金夕阳光晕与树影
data.promptProse: In a first-person POV perspective, Izumi pauses while pushing her bicycle up a sun-drenched cherry blossom slope, looking up directly at the viewer with blushing cheeks and an earnest confession about her dreams.
data.animaCaption: Golden sunset rays filter through falling cherry petals as Izumi looks straight at the viewer with flushed cheeks while pushing her bicycle.
